chunks: "You instruct your dying ones: 'There is no god but Allah' at the time of death, while we instruct our dying ones: 'Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.'"

key_terms.تُلَقِّنُونَ: you prompt or instruct someone to recite
key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: the declaration of tawhid that none is worthy of worship but Allah
key_terms.مَوْتَاكُمْ: your dying ones or those at death
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the declaration that Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم is the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.نُلَقِّنُ: we prompt or instruct to recite

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say should be recited to the dying at the time of death?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام contrasts two forms of talqin given at the time of death. The narration emphasizes affirming the message of Allah through the shahadah of the Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in the final moments of life.
